name: research
_: Fan-out / join. Two independent lenses run in parallel (web vs. local code), then one synthesis node reconciles them. Router-style: each lens goes to the model that is actually good at it. ОГОВОРКА с 2026-09-06: веб-проход снят с agy (region-blocked) и переведён на claude, поэтому синтез больше НЕ независим — он сводит в том числе собственный проход. Вернуть web на третьего агента, как только он появится.

nodes.prompt:
Research this on the live web. Prefer primary sources (official docs, source repos, release notes) over blog summaries.

QUESTION:
{input}

Output: findings as claims, each with the URL that supports it, each marked [confirmed] or [uncertain]. Note explicitly what you could NOT verify.

Answer this from THIS repository only — code, configs, git history. Do not use outside knowledge.

QUESTION:
{input}

Output: what the codebase actually does today, with file:line citations. State plainly where the repo is silent.
